components.name: backward semantic liveness compiler for certificate state
components.project_addition: Applies canonical P023 future-safe quotient recursively to certificate state in a staged deterministic program. Complete suffix signatures yield the unique coarsest certificate quotient at every point; candidate erasure is safe iff its kernel is contained in the suffix equivalence, with an exact counterexample pair on failure. This supplies last-use semantics for certificate demotion and makes no new generic minimization claim.
